ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
